subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The supervisor is _______ (**ruthless**) in his behaviour with the workers.
solution: The correct answer is **"merciless."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Ruthless"** means showing no mercy or compassion. ((व्‍यक्ति और उनका आचरण) कठोर और निर्मम; इच्‍छापूर्ति पर अटल और दूसरों के प्रति असंवेदनशील) • **Example**: *The **ruthless**__ dictator ordered the execution of hundreds of innocent people.* • The synonym for** 'ruthless'** is **'merciless.'** • **"Merciless"** means showing no mercy. (दयाहीन या निर्मम) __ • **Example**: *There are reports of **merciless**__ attacks on innocent civilians.* • The correct answer is Option 1. **Correct sentence**: *The supervisor is __**merciless**__ in his behaviour with the workers. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (senseless)** means lacking sense or understanding. (निरर्थक या निरुद्देश्‍य) • **Option 3 (shameless)** means having no shame or embarrassment. (ढीठ (ग़लत काम करने के लिए व्‍याकुलता का अनुभव न करने वाला); बेशर्म, निर्लज्ज) • **Option 4 (careless)** means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors. (असावधान, लापरवाह) 2f:Tc0c, The correct answer is **"Respect."**
